summary: After Jon cancelled for the guest, /manage read 'Cancelled, no guilt' (the guest's own-cancel line) and offered no way to send new times, so the guest could only start over from the menu.
fix: A Jon cancel (cancelled_by 'jon', not closed in person) reads 'Cancelled, no problem' and offers Ask for another time; the re-request takes the same row back to requested for Jon (E16) and keeps the manage link alive. The guest's own cancel is unchanged.
